verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state 'Create your first agent with a single command and start building,' indicating an official CLI/one-command scaffold, and Mastra ships an MCP docs server that AI coding agents can use to understand APIs while scaffolding. However, there's no explicit named CLI command (e.g. 'create-mastra') shown, no template gallery evidence, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the one-command flow. missing for 10: explicit CLI command name/syntax, evidence of multiple project templates, independent hands-on confirmation that scaffolding works as advertised.
